user.title: Powerness M01 / EPP BES
user.description: How do you want to set up the battery?

menu_options.cloud: Log in with the Smart Life / Tuya app (recommended)
menu_options.manual: Enter device ID and local key manually

cloud.title: Smart Life login
cloud.description:
Open the Smart Life or Tuya Smart app, go to **Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code** and enter the code here. The cloud is only used once to read the local key, the battery is then controlled locally.

{msg}

scan.title: Scan QR code
scan.description: Scan this QR code with the Smart Life / Tuya app, confirm the login in the app and then press **Submit**.

locate.title: Battery not found on the network
locate.description: {name} did not announce itself on the network. Enter its IP address (see your router).

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Leave the IP address empty to search the network automatically.

error.login_error: Login failed. Check the user code and confirm the login in the app.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the battery. Is another integration (e.g. LocalTuya) connected to it? Tuya devices accept only one local connection.
error.invalid_auth: The battery rejected the local key.
error.not_found: The battery was not found on the network, please enter the IP address.

abort.no_devices: No devices found in this account.
abort.device_not_found: The battery was not found in this account.

data_description.keep_alive: The battery only streams live values while the app is open. With this option the integration sends the same request whenever the data goes stale.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the battery's time schedule with up to four periods. The schedule only applies while both permanent switches are off.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: Up to four periods with start, end (HH:MM, 23:59 for midnight) and mode (charge or discharge).
